description: Read summary (default), profile, settings or questions. questions includes revision, versioned profile references and blocking_gaps from the same check used at calculation acceptance. Check before a requested calculation; ask targeted questions for blockers, save replies and recheck. Other interview questions may remain optional; empty blocking_gaps does not establish visa eligibility. Read current arrays/revision before edits; reuse authoritative saved state. Unknown facts remain unknown. Requires the authenticated One U Education account and declared planning scope; credentials and user identity are never tool arguments.
name: get_planning_dossier
